jobs.title: Associate Director, Client Data Team
jobs.description:
About MUFG Investor Services

Experience something Brilliantly Different.

At MUFG Investor Services, we partner with some of the world’s most sophisticated public and private funds to help them operate with confidence and scale. We bring together fund administration, banking, and operational expertise to solve complex challenges across the alternatives space.

With over $1 trillion in assets under administration
and a global presence across 17 locations
, we combine deep industry knowledge with the strength of MUFG — one of the world’s largest financial institutions with approximately $3 trillion in assets
.

Here, you’ll do work that matters from day one. You’ll collaborate with smart, driven teams, build your expertise across complex fund structures, and grow your career in an environment that values curiosity, accountability, and new ideas. To learn more, visit us at www.mufg-investorservices.com.

Job Description

In this role, you will assist the Business Data Office – Client Data Team fulfilling mandate of ingesting and maintaining static data for clients, Data Migration and remediation, solution verification, testing and investment data maintenance for Fund of Funds.

Acknowledge and complete requests for data updates from stakeholders (Client Integration & Operations)
Assist accounting and operations team in capturing and maintaining client and investment data
Assist with regular data clean up, bulk ingestion or data migration.
Work with guidance from director to assess solutions and assist in legacy replacement and modernization initiatives (For in-house systems: Origin and MTC)
Validate data update requests and communicate missing or invalid info back to requesting user.
Extract and/or Collect data from various structured and unstructured formats (csv, PDF, email) and ingest into appropriate system.
Collaborate with Data Integrity & Operation to resolve data incidents and assist with data remediation efforts.
Adhere to standard operating procedure when updating MUFG system
Update Operating Procedures and maintain JIRA/ServiceDesk/Confluence up to date
Assist in standardizing and simplifying processes for creating and maintaining client and investor data.
Participate in multiple initiatives with Technology, Product and other stakeholders to digitize and automate the ingestion and maintenance of client and investor data.
Ensure internal checklists are completed and signed off.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Technical or Analytical fields
Minimum 6+ years' experience in financial services data management with people management experience
Experience in back office OR business processing practices

Additional Information

What’s in it for you to join MUFG Investor Services?

Take a look at our careers site and you’ll find everything you’d expect from a career with the fastest-growing business at one of the world’s largest financial groups. Now take another look. Because it’s how we defy expectations that really defines us. You’ll feel that difference in all kinds of ways. Our vibrant CULTURE. Connected team. Love of innovation, laser client focus, and next-level LEARNING & DEVELOPMENT. Oh, and we really walk the talk when it comes to HYBRID WORKING.   

So, why settle for the ordinary? Apply now for a Brilliantly Different career.

We are committed to using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools responsibly and being transparent about what we do to build trust and confidence. At MUFG Investor Services, we use AI tools to support our recruitment process by helping us understand how well candidates’ applications align with the requirements of the role.

All AI recommendations are reviewed by our recruitment team before any decisions are made.

More information on our use of AI tools is available in our Privacy Notice available to you as part of your application.

We thank all candidates for applying; however, only those proceeding to the interview stage will be contacted.

MUFG is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Workshop Director - CIO Advisory / AI
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

Infotech's members come to us for our advisory services, value added research, and our passion for driving measurable business results. If you are looking to be part of an IT research firm that relentlessly creates innovative advisory products and transformational IT research solutions, we would like to speak with you. You will work for a rapidly growing company that understands the importance of supporting employees through flexibility, inclusiveness, learning and development, internal career mobility, measurement of the Employee Experience and actioning on employee feedback and building strong relationships.

Due to continued growth in our workshop offering, we are expanding our team of talented professionals to support our member base. We offer a high learning, dynamic, and progressive culture focused on evolving the field of information technology. This role is ideal for someone who -

Excels in Leveraging practical experience to improve client strategies, processes, and project execution.
Has subject matter expertise in one of more of the following subject areas.
Strategy and governance; leadership; project portfolio management; enterprise architecture; service management; service desk; IT operations; infrastructure management; data management; enterprise applications; application development; security and risk management.

Excels in facilitating and engaging cross-functional groups of IT and business professionals via interactive presentations, training and/or workshops.
Excels in Learning and flexibly communicating IT best practices to meet the needs of diverse organizations, industries, situations, and audiences.

What You Will Do, Includes, But Not Limited To

As a Workshop Director you will be actively engaged in delivering measurable value to Infotech's members by utilizing our IT Best Practice methodologies, detailed in our Blueprints, to deliver online or on-site structured 1-week workshops designed to help improve their strategies, processes, and organizational effectiveness.

Duties & Responsibilities

Engagement Scoping: Work with clients over the phone to properly scope and formalize the objectives, agenda, deliverables, and overall workshop effort in advance of online or onsite delivery.
Workshop Delivery: Lead the delivery of four-day workshops, online or onsite, based on Infotech’s Best Practice Methodology Blueprints.
Work with client cross-functional teams to define the scope and outcomes of their IT initiatives / projects, perform capability maturity assessments, and gap analyses, and identify member improvement opportunities/recommendations.
Client Service: Identify client need for continued advisory service and support after the workshop.
Assist in the development of Statements of Work to formalize the objective, agenda, and deliverables of workshops.

Commercial Activity: Identify opportunities to provide additional advisory services, workshop, consulting engagements, and services to our clients after the workshop.
Research Support: Transmit new knowledge and lessons learned during workshop interactions to influence and improve the research agenda and content. On occasion, develop client case studies and/or industry research notes.
Contribute to Infotech research by developing client case studies and/or industry research notes.
Generate insight and providing expertise to assist with the development of our research content.

Collaboration & Support: Work collaboratively with others to:
Design and build high-quality keynote/other presentations, and successful delivery of presentations as needed.
Play a lead role in building internal AI capabilities at Infotech, including internal agent development, tool prototypes, knowledge sharing and AI-enhanced workflows.

Education & Experience

To be successful, you will need:

Undergraduate degree in Business, IT, or related discipline. MBA is an asset or equivalent.
Minimum of 5-10+ years progressive experience in IT leadership OR consulting roles within medium to large organizations (IT team size between 25 and 500 FTEs).
Consulting roles within large organizations is a definite advantage
Acquired experience in more than one of the following areas:
IT Strategy, IT Governance (COBIT, ITIL), Organizational Structure, Digital Business, IT Cost, IT Risk Management, Business Relationship Management, Service Catalog, Service Management,
AI Strategy, AI Governance, AI Literacy, Agentic AI, various AI tools knowledge,

Especially valuable experience (definite advantage) in more than one of the following:
Enterprise Architecture, Security, Zero Trust, Ransomware, Risk, Privacy, Information Security,
IT Service Desk/Operations, Infrastructure/Cloud Strategy, Disaster Recovery Planning, Asset Management, Cloud Operations, Incident & Problem Management,
Data Strategy, Data Governance, Enterprise Content Management,
Application Development, Enterprise Application (ERP/HRIS/CRM/ECM) selection and Implementation, Rationalization, SDLC,
Agile, Project Portfolio Management, Resource Management, Digital Product,

Superior interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, exceptional ability to work well with others.
The ability, flexibility, and enthusiasm to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing, and energetic environment.
Previous experience presenting to a C-Suite audience.
Certifications in an IT or project management related topic e.g. PMP, COBIT 5, ITIL are considered beneficial
Deep understanding of current and emerging technologies, how other enterprises are employing them to drive digital business, and how they may be applied to the enterprise to drive digital business.

Skills

Client Interaction and Facilitation; Ability to build rapport and communicate effectively with clients and particularly through the facilitation of workshops online or in-person with an audience of 5 to 20 clients (mid management to executive management).
Exceptional presentation, facilitation, writing, interpersonal communication, and collaboration skills.
Public Speaking ability to speak to a larger group (50+) of individuals

Problem solving; decision making, knowledge management, managing through change & uncertainty and dynamic learning mindset
Client Advisory and Service Delivery; lead multiple clients through complex projects by providing guidance, critical analysis, and support
Proven ability to build rapport, credibility, and trust with clients at all levels and across all disciplines. Build client relationships and established themselves as a trusted advisor (SME) in their space
Opportunity Identification and Definition; lead multiple clients through structured working sessions; can facilitate an inclusive discussion in order to meet clear objectives
Project Management; ability to work independently and remotely for extended periods of time.

Travel Requirement:
This role will involve travel, for on-site engagements. Willingness and ability to travel 50% of the time (2 weeks per month) is required. Must hold a valid driver’s licence.

Visa Requirement:
Must be eligible to obtain appropriate work Visa for cross-border work within North America and globally.

Work Hours Requirements:
Must be available for after-hours work periodically to service Global (Americas/EMEA/APAC) clients.

Language Skills
: Bilingual proficiency in French, Spanish or German is preferred to support our diverse client base across North America and globally.

Infotech Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic including Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Veteran and are pleased to consider all qualified applicants. To that end, upon request, Infotech will ensure, to the extent possible, that accommodation be made available to applicants throughout the recruitment and hiring process.

jobs.title: Global Head of Digital Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
Location:
Toronto, Canada
Salary:
Competitive executive package, dependent on experience and location
Employment:
Permanent | Full-time
Industry:
Legal & Professional Services

Ingenio is supporting a leading international law firm with the appointment of a Global Head of Digital Strategy & Transformation
.

This is a senior leadership position reporting directly to the Global Chief Operating Officer, with significant exposure to the Board and wider executive leadership team. The successful candidate will lead the firm's digital transformation strategy, bringing together business applications, data, AI, automation and digital client services to deliver measurable business improvements.

This is not a traditional IT infrastructure or operational technology role. An established CTO is responsible for those areas. The focus of this appointment is on strategy, development, transformation and execution
.

The Opportunity
You will take responsibility for developing and delivering a global digital transformation strategy across legal, corporate and trust services. Working with senior business stakeholders, you will turn commercial and operational challenges into practical technology solutions that improve efficiency, client experience and service delivery.

You'll inherit an established application development team and will be responsible for developing its capabilities as the transformation programme progresses.

Significant projects are already underway, including a major entity-management platform initiative, a broader data management and analytics programme, and opportunities to extend the use of AI and automation across the business.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and deliver a global digital strategy and transformation roadmap aligned with business priorities.
Lead and develop the existing Business Technology and Application Development team.
Own the business applications roadmap, including entity management and client-facing technology solutions.
Oversee the design, development and delivery of new systems, whether built internally, purchased or delivered through external partners.
Drive the data strategy, analytics, reporting and business intelligence agenda.
Identify and implement practical AI and automation opportunities across legal and professional services.

What We're Looking For
We are particularly interested in senior digital transformation and business technology leaders from professional services, legal, fiduciary/corporate services, financial services or similarly complex, regulated environments
.

You will bring:
Significant experience leading digital strategy, business technology or enterprise transformation.
A proven track record of delivering complex technology programmes with measurable business outcomes.
Strong experience across business applications, software development and technology-enabled process improvement.
A solid understanding of data strategy, analytics, business intelligence, AI and automation.
Experience leading multidisciplinary development teams and managing external delivery partners.
The ability to influence Board-level stakeholders while remaining technically credible and close to delivery.

Location & Package
Toronto is the mandatory location, with this being an in-office role. with Bermuda also an option for suitably qualified candidates.

Interested?
This is an opportunity to shape the digital direction of an established international professional services organisation, with direct access to senior leadership, an existing development capability and significant transformation programmes already underway.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Michelle Queally at Ingenio
, or apply directly.

Show more

Show less

Director

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Staffing and Recruiting
